section_summary: This section records requests and replies concerning visits by Japanese transports Iro and Erimo to Los Angeles and Hawaiian ports in 1940. It also contains customs instructions prompted by an armed-sentry incident at Hilo, a consular account of an earlier comparable dispute at Yokohama, and Navy reports on the October 1939 visit of a Japanese training squadron. State, War, and Navy correspondence considers restricting foreign public vessels to Honolulu when visiting Hawaii.

subfiles.title: Labor Department acknowledgment of Iro schedule change
subfiles.about: The Iro's Los Angeles call was rescheduled to January 22 while its Hilo call remained February 6.
subfiles.summary: Labor will inform its Los Angeles office of the change.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledgment of revised Iro itinerary
subfiles.about: The Iro's Los Angeles visit shifted again, to January 21.
subfiles.summary: War forwarded the schedule to the Ninth Corps Area.

subfiles.title: Treasury notice concerning Iro
subfiles.about: Treasury notified Los Angeles customs of Iro's January 21 arrival.
subfiles.summary: The collector of customs is being advised.

subfiles.title: File note on customs instructions in Hawaii
subfiles.about: Commerce revised instructions for Japanese public vessels after State and Treasury discussed them.
subfiles.summary: State considered Commerce's action satisfactory and closed the matter.

subfiles.title: Commerce transmittal of radiogram
subfiles.about: Commerce provided a copy of its instructions to the Honolulu collector.
subfiles.summary: Cover letter enclosing the radiogram.

subfiles.title: Radiogram revising customs restrictions
subfiles.about: Commerce ordered revision of restrictions on sea stores, ship stores, and cargo for Japanese transports.
subfiles.summary: The collector was told to permit supplies and lawful cargo, and to seek approval before issuing instructions to foreign representatives.

subfiles.title: Labor acknowledgment of second Iro schedule change
subfiles.about: Labor acknowledged that Iro would visit Los Angeles on January 21.
subfiles.summary: Its Los Angeles office was being advised.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note on third Iro schedule change
subfiles.about: Japan requested approval for Iro to visit Los Angeles on January 23 instead of January 21.
subfiles.summary: The Hilo visit remained February 6; the ambassador apologized for repeated changes.

subfiles.title: State acknowledgment of Iro itinerary
subfiles.about: State acknowledged Iro's January 23 Los Angeles visit and unchanged Hilo call.
subfiles.summary: Interested federal authorities had been informed.

subfiles.title: Treasury request for comments on Hilo customs rules
subfiles.about: Treasury sought State's views on customs instructions issued after the Yakumo sentry incident.
subfiles.summary: Harris enclosed Honolulu's letter to the Japanese consul on the forthcoming Shiriya and Iro visits.

subfiles.title: Honolulu customs instructions for Japanese transports
subfiles.about: The Honolulu collector specified customs controls for Shiriya and Iro at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Rules covered guards, boarding priority, supplies, cargo, pier access, receptions, baggage inspection, and customs lines.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Erimo visits
subfiles.about: Japan sought Erimo visits to Los Angeles for petroleum and Honolulu for food and water.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador also asked about crew landing and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Request to California governor concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo's Los Angeles and Honolulu calls.
subfiles.summary: The governor was informed of the proposed itinerary.

subfiles.title: Request to Labor concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The note reports planned petroleum and provisioning calls.

subfiles.title: Request to Agriculture concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The note reports planned Los Angeles and Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Request to Interior concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The note reports planned petroleum and provisioning calls.

subfiles.title: Request to War concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The note reports planned Los Angeles and Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Request to Treasury concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The note reports planned petroleum and provisioning calls.

subfiles.title: Request to Navy concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State sought Navy's view on Erimo's visits and crew landing.
subfiles.summary: The proposed ports were Los Angeles and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Interim reply to Japanese ambassador concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State acknowledged Erimo's request pending responses from federal departments and California.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador would be informed after replies arrived.

subfiles.title: Commerce letter enclosing Bureau Memorandum 258
subfiles.about: Commerce explained customs requirements for foreign public vessels loading cargo.
subfiles.summary: Jones enclosed a memorandum requiring compliance with clearance law.

subfiles.title: Bureau Memorandum 258 on foreign public vessels
subfiles.to: Collectors and deputy collectors of customs
subfiles.about: Foreign public vessels loading cargo for foreign ports must comply with applicable law.
subfiles.summary: Officers should notify commanders of violations and report any refusal to comply.

subfiles.title: War Department approval of Erimo courtesies
subfiles.about: War instructed its California and Hawaiian commands to extend courtesies to Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The letter acknowledges the Los Angeles and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.title: Treasury authorization of Erimo customs courtesies
subfiles.about: Treasury authorized customs courtesies for Erimo at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Both collectors were being notified.

subfiles.title: State reply setting Erimo departure condition
subfiles.about: State approved Erimo's Los Angeles visit if it departed by noon February 26.
subfiles.summary: An arrival one or two days earlier was acceptable; the Honolulu call also met no objection.

subfiles.title: Consular despatch on Yokohama and Hilo sentry incidents
subfiles.about: Boyce compared the Yakumo sentry at Hilo with Japanese objections to an armed USS Augusta guard at Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: He enclosed a 1936 memorandum describing the guard dispute and other shore incidents.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on USS Augusta and Yokohama police
subfiles.about: Japanese police objected to an armed American guard ashore during USS Augusta's Yokohama visit.
subfiles.summary: The guard was disarmed. Boyce also recorded several sailors' arrests, disputed claims of mistreatment, fines, and his view that police exaggerated minor incidents.

subfiles.title: Later file memorandum on Hawaiian port restrictions
subfiles.about: A retrospective memorandum traces policy on restricting foreign public vessels to Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: It recounts Navy's 1940 proposal, State's concern about relations with Japan, and the July 1940 decision to call other Hawaiian ports inconvenient for foreign public vessels. It distinguishes merchant ships and suggests customs safeguards against propaganda.

subfiles.title: Document list for Hawaiian port restriction correspondence
subfiles.about: The sheet lists related February and July 1940 letters.
subfiles.summary: Four letters are indexed by date and file number.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs assessment of Navy proposal
subfiles.about: Far Eastern Affairs assessed Navy's proposal to confine Japanese government vessels to Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The division reviewed reported fundraising, photography, and the Hilo sentry incident. It warned that restrictions could harm cooperation with Japan's Navy in China waters and would agree in principle only if the policy applied to all foreign government vessels.

subfiles.title: Protocol request for Far Eastern Affairs view
subfiles.about: Protocol requested a position on Navy's proposed Hawaiian visit restrictions.
subfiles.summary: Far Eastern Affairs was asked to return its view for a reply.

subfiles.title: Navy proposal to restrict Japanese vessel visits
subfiles.about: Navy recommended that proposed Japanese visits to Hawaiian ports other than Honolulu be called inconvenient.
subfiles.summary: Reports on the October 1939 Japanese training squadron visit to Hilo were enclosed.

subfiles.title: Fourteenth Naval District report on Hilo squadron visit
subfiles.about: The commandant reported the squadron's Hilo visit, customs dispute, desertion, and political activity.
subfiles.summary: The report identifies fundraising and ties with Hawaiian Japanese residents as purposes of the visit. It describes the armed sentry's demand that a customs inspector salute and records Mario Sato's desertion. It also refers to revised customs rules and lectures encouraging donations to Japan.

subfiles.title: Naval intelligence observer's report on Hilo visit
subfiles.from: District Intelligence Officer, Fourteenth Naval District
subfiles.about: An observer documented the Japanese training squadron's October 1939 activities at Hilo and across Hawaii island.
subfiles.summary: The report describes the ships' arrival, receptions, lectures, excursions, photography, and local reactions. It investigates the armed-sentry incident and interviews deserter Mario Sato about his claimed Peruvian citizenship, conscription, shipboard conditions, and attitudes toward the United States. The observer concludes that the visit increased local tension and gave Japanese agents opportunities for contacts and propaganda.

subfiles.title: Commandant's concluding recommendation
subfiles.about: The commandant urged further consideration of limiting Japanese vessel visits to Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: He noted extensive photography and contacts, though no special intelligence activity was observed.

subfiles.title: State reply to Navy's Hawaiian port proposal
subfiles.about: State opposed immediate restriction of Japanese government vessels to Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The surviving pages begin at page two of the letter. State feared damage to naval relations in China waters, noted that customs measures should prevent another armed-sentry incident, and would agree to a restriction on defense grounds if applied to all foreign governments.

subfiles.title: Duplicate closing page of State reply to Navy
subfiles.about: The page repeats the conditional agreement to a general foreign-vessel restriction.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate closing page of the preceding letter.

subfiles.title: State letter to Acting Secretary of War on Hawaiian ports
subfiles.about: State announced that future requests by foreign public vessels for Hawaiian ports other than Honolulu would be called inconvenient.
subfiles.summary: Pages 59 and 60 duplicate the opening page. The letter cites Marshall's and Stark's recommendation, distinguishes merchant vessels from public vessels, and suggests customs safeguards against propaganda activity at Hawaiian outports.

subfiles.title: State letter to Acting Secretary of Navy on Hawaiian ports
subfiles.about: State informed Navy of the same policy on foreign public vessels visiting Hawaiian outports.
subfiles.summary: Pages 63 and 64 duplicate the opening page. State would call visits outside Honolulu inconvenient, while doubting the practicality of closing ports to peaceful merchant ships. It proposed consultation on customs safeguards.

subfiles.title: Protocol file note on Navy's unanswered proposal
subfiles.about: Protocol noted that Navy had not answered State's conditional response on restricting visits to Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The note recaps the February correspondence.

subfiles.title: Labor approval of courtesies for Erimo
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner, Immigration and Naturalization Service
subfiles.about: Labor directed its Los Angeles and Honolulu representatives to extend lawful courtesies to Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The letter repeats Erimo's petroleum and provisioning itinerary.

subfiles.title: Duplicate Labor letter concerning Erimo
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner, Immigration and Naturalization Service
subfiles.about: A second OCR copy repeats Labor's Erimo courtesy instructions.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate of the preceding letter.

subfiles.title: Draft request to Agriculture concerning later Erimo voyage
subfiles.about: State prepared a request for courtesies for Erimo's May Los Angeles and June Hilo visits.
subfiles.summary: The draft also asks about landing the crew.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note requesting later Erimo visits
subfiles.about: Japan sought Erimo calls at Los Angeles on May 21 and Hilo on June 6.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador requested customary courtesies and permission for crew landing.

subfiles.title: Duplicate Protocol note on Navy proposal
subfiles.about: Protocol again noted Navy's silence after State's February reply on Hawaiian port restrictions.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate of the note on page 67.

subfiles.title: Draft request to Navy concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State prepared a request for Navy's view on Erimo's May and June calls and crew landing.
subfiles.summary: The proposed ports were Los Angeles and Hilo.

subfiles.title: Request to California governor concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo's Los Angeles and Hilo calls.
subfiles.summary: The note also mentions the crew-landing request.

subfiles.title: Request to Agriculture concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo's May and June calls.
subfiles.summary: The note includes the crew-landing question.

subfiles.title: Request to Interior concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo at Los Angeles and Hilo.
subfiles.summary: The note includes the crew-landing question.

subfiles.title: Request to Labor concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo's May and June visits.
subfiles.summary: The note includes the crew-landing question.

subfiles.title: Request to Navy concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies and Navy's view on crew landing during Erimo's visits.
subfiles.summary: The proposed ports were Los Angeles and Hilo.

subfiles.title: Request to Treasury concerning Erimo
subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo at Los Angeles and Hilo.
subfiles.summary: The note includes the crew-landing question.

subfiles.about: State requested customary courtesies for Erimo's May Los Angeles and June Hilo calls.
subfiles.summary: The note includes the crew-landing question.
